download_pdf_from_arxiv: download a PDF from an arXiv URL and optionally save it to a specified file path
extract_arxiv_pdf_url: extract the direct PDF URL from an arXiv abs or html URL format
extract_text_from_pdf: extract all text content from a PDF file using PyPDF2 page by page
extract_references_with_llm: use Llama 4 via Together AI to extract arXiv citations and IDs from a research paper PDF
download_arxiv_paper_and_citations: download an arXiv paper and all its cited reference PDFs into a directory
